testType: live in-app browser interaction and rendered screenshots
operations: Reset to A-course start and confirm four wheel contacts
W forward to the turnaround checkpoint
D steering while coasting at the mid-course location
S braking and reverse along the validated course ribbon
Return to route station 0 and allow speed to settle to 0.0 km/h; GOAL displayed

demDeltaCm.meaning: Rendered OSM road surface is used as support; these are differences from DEM sampling, not applied terrain edits.

limitations: DEV residuals are the four GLB wheel bounding-box lowest-point samples relative to the rendered OSM road triangles, not physical suspension or tire deformation.
The road-to-DEM differences near 8.6–14.6 cm reflect source surface disagreement; neither surface was modified.
37.5 FPS was a transient observed capture; most live HUD readings were 60.1 FPS.
